chats.answer:
If you're looking for a trail camera that works without Wi-Fi, you want a non-cellular trail camera (also called a standalone trail camera).

These cameras are ideal for wildlife monitoring, hunting, or property surveillance in remote areas.

How they work

No Wi-Fi required: The camera records automatically when it detects motion.

No cellular service: No SIM card, subscription, or monthly fees.

SD card storage: Photos and videos are saved locally.

Battery-powered: Most run on AA batteries, while some support solar power.

Night vision: Infrared LEDs allow recording at night.

The main limitation is that you'll generally need to retrieve the SD card or visit the camera to view recordings.
